title: Kaltura Reports Second-Quarter Revenue Growth as AI Deal Momentum Accelerates
excerpt: The enterprise software company exceeded second-quarter guidance, reported record AI-related customer wins, and highlighted growing commercial traction for i...
content_html:
Fiona Craig

Wed, August 5, 2026 at 10:47 AM EDT 3 min read

The enterprise software company exceeded second-quarter guidance, reported record AI-related customer wins, and highlighted growing commercial traction for its agentic digital experience platform while maintaining its full-year outlook.

Key Investor Takeaways

  • Kaltura (NASDAQ:KLTR) exceeded second-quarter guidance with revenue rising 5% to $46.9 million and adjusted EBITDA increasing to $5.9 million.

  • The company signed a record 14 AI-related deals during the quarter, including nine involving its Agentic Avatars technology and eight with new customers.

  • Annualized recurring revenue (ARR) increased 8% to $184.6 million, while subscription revenue grew 8% year over year.

  • Record non-GAAP gross margin of 75% and improved operating profitability reflected continued operational efficiency.

  • Management expects stronger bookings momentum in the second half of 2026, with more meaningful revenue contributions from new AI products anticipated in 2027.

Why KLTR Stock Is in Focus

Kaltura (NASDAQ:KLTR) reported second-quarter 2026 revenue of $46.9 million, up 5% from the prior year, while subscription revenue increased 8% to $45.6 million. Annualized recurring revenue climbed to $184.6 million, also representing 8% year-over-year growth.

Profitability continued to improve. GAAP operating loss narrowed to $0.8 million from $2.8 million a year earlier, while non-GAAP operating profit increased to $4.8 million. Adjusted EBITDA reached $5.9 million, exceeding the company's guidance and marking its strongest second-quarter adjusted EBITDA performance to date. Non-GAAP gross margin also reached a record 75%.

The quarter also highlighted accelerating adoption of Kaltura's AI offerings. The company signed a record 14 contracts that included AI products, doubling its previous high. Nine of those agreements included Agentic Avatars, while eight were with new customers across industries including financial services, healthcare, education, technology, media, and professional services.

Kaltura also advanced the integration of its eSelf.ai and PathFactory acquisitions, expanded enterprise AI capabilities across its platform, and continued developing two strategic offerings focused on Agentic Revenue Engagement and Agentic Learning & Enablement.

For the third quarter, the company expects revenue between $45.8 million and $46.5 million with adjusted EBITDA of $2.0 million to $3.0 million. Full-year guidance calls for total revenue between $183.0 million and $185.0 million and adjusted EBITDA of $15.8 million to $17.2 million.

菲奥娜·克雷格

2026 年 8 月 5 日星期三，美国东部时间上午 10:47 阅读 3 分钟

这家企业软件公司超出了第二季度指导，报告了创纪录的人工智能相关客户赢得情况，并强调其代理数字体验平台不断增长的商业吸引力，同时维持全年展望。

主要投资者要点

  • Kaltura（纳斯达克股票代码：KLTR）超出第二季度指引，收入增长 5% 至 4690 万美元，调整后 EBITDA 增至 590 万美元。
  • 该公司在本季度签署了创纪录的 14 项人工智能相关交易，其中 9 项涉及 Agentic Avatars 技术，8 项涉及新客户。
  • 年化经常性收入 (ARR) 增长 8%，达到 1.846 亿美元，订阅收入同比增长 8%。
  • 创纪录的非公认会计准则毛利率为 75%，运营利润率的提高反映了持续的运营效率。
  • 管理层预计 2026 年下半年的预订势头将更加强劲，预计新的人工智能产品将在 2027 年带来更有意义的收入贡献。

为什么 KLTR 股票成为焦点

Kaltura（纳斯达克股票代码：KLTR）公布 2026 年第二季度收入为 4690 万美元，比上年增长 5%，订阅收入增长 8% 至 4560 万美元。 年化经常性收入攀升至 1.846 亿美元，同比增长 8%。

盈利能力持续改善。 GAAP 运营亏损从上年同期的 280 万美元收窄至 80 万美元，而非 GAAP 运营利润则增至 480 万美元。 调整后的 EBITDA 达到 590 万美元，超出了公司的指导，并创下了迄今为止最强劲的第二季度调整后 EBITDA 表现。 非 GAAP 毛利率也达到创纪录的 75%。

该季度还强调了 Kaltura 人工智能产品的加速采用。 该公司签署了创纪录的 14 份包含人工智能产品的合同，是之前最高纪录的两倍。 其中九项协议涉及 Agentic Avatars，另外八项协议涉及金融服务、医疗保健、教育、技术、媒体和专业服务等行业的新客户。

Kaltura 还推进了其 eSelf.ai 和 PathFactory 收购的整合，在其平台上扩展了企业人工智能功能，并继续开发专注于代理收入参与和代理学习与支持的两项战略产品。

该公司预计第三季度收入在 4580 万美元至 4650 万美元之间，调整后 EBITDA 为 200 万美元至 300 万美元。 全年指导要求总收入在 1.83 亿美元至 1.85 亿美元之间，调整后 EBITDA 为 1,580 万美元至 1,720 万美元。
